note: Curated knowledge base: reinforcement learning from foundations to LLM-era RL. Source facts (title, venue, one-line summary, mechanism) are stated as the work describes itself; the alignment columns are this repo's assessment. Identifiers are given where verified; where an identifier is not verified, the url is a search that always resolves. Concept ids shared with data/sl_landscape.json (credit-assignment, memory-policy-learning, experience-evolution, continual-learning, verifier-feedback) are the native interlinks between the two graphs; works carry explicit sl_links and rl_links on top.

dimensions.label: RL family
dimensions.question: Which family of reinforcement learning does the work belong to?

dimensions.label: Learning signal
dimensions.question: What scalar or textual signal does the agent learn from?

dimensions.label: Policy substrate
dimensions.question: What is the thing that changes when the agent learns?

dimensions.label: Exploration
dimensions.question: How does the agent try things it has not tried before?

dimensions.label: Update stability
dimensions.question: What stops one update from destroying what earlier updates learned?

dimensions.label: Evaluation discipline
dimensions.question: How is improvement measured — and is degradation measured too?

dimensions.label: Cost reported
dimensions.question: Does the work report what learning costs: environment steps, tokens, or both?

dimensions.label: Agent scope
dimensions.question: Does the work study one agent's policy or behaviour shared across agents?

concepts.label: Markov decision processes
concepts.gloss: States, actions, rewards and transitions: the formal frame every RL result is stated in.

concepts.label: Temporal-difference learning
concepts.gloss: Learn from the difference between successive predictions instead of waiting for the final outcome.

concepts.label: Value-based methods
concepts.gloss: Learn how good states or actions are (Q-learning, DQN, Rainbow) and act greedily on the values.

concepts.label: Policy gradients
concepts.gloss: Move the policy directly uphill on expected return (REINFORCE, A3C, PPO): the optimizer is the gradient of performance.

concepts.label: Actor-critic
concepts.gloss: A policy (actor) proposes, a value function (critic) judges: lower variance than pure gradients, broader than pure values.

concepts.label: Trust regions and clipping
concepts.gloss: Bound each update so the new policy cannot leave the neighbourhood of the old one (TRPO, PPO clipping, KL penalties).

concepts.label: Model-based planning
concepts.gloss: Learn a model of the world, then plan inside it (MuZero, Dreamer) instead of learning purely from trial and error.

concepts.label: Offline reinforcement learning
concepts.gloss: Learn a policy from a fixed log of past behaviour with no new environment interaction — the counterfactual discipline.

concepts.label: Preference-based RL
concepts.gloss: Learn the reward itself from human comparisons before optimising it: the reward is a model, not a given.

concepts.label: RLHF
concepts.gloss: Fine-tune a language model against a learned human-preference reward with a KL anchor to the base policy (InstructGPT).

concepts.label: RLVR and reasoning RL
concepts.gloss: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards: grade reasoning chains on checkable outcomes and let long chains emerge (DeepSeek-R1, GRPO).

concepts.label: Reward hacking
concepts.gloss: Optimising the proxy instead of the goal: the better the optimizer, the worse the hack.

concepts.label: Exploration vs exploitation
concepts.gloss: Trying the unknown against milking the known — every RL result prices this trade somewhere.

concepts.label: Credit assignment
concepts.gloss: Deciding which part of a long trajectory deserves credit.

concepts.label: Memory-policy learning
concepts.gloss: The agent learns how to manage memory - what to store, retrieve, update or discard - not just what to remember. A-MEM's RL-trained memory operators and MemRL's runtime RL are the first instances.

concepts.label: Experience evolution
concepts.gloss: Forward learning from the experience stream itself: each interaction updates the reusable repertoire (reasoning memory, latent memory, skill set) rather than only the current answer.

concepts.label: Continual learning
concepts.gloss: Learning over a stream that keeps changing, with interference and forgetting as the cost.

concepts.label: Verifier feedback
concepts.gloss: A checker, grader or environment decides success, and only success is learned from.

works.title: Dynamic Programming
works.summary: Optimal sequential decisions satisfy a recursion: the value of a state is the best immediate reward plus the value of what follows.
works.mechanism: The Bellman optimality equation; value iteration and policy iteration on known models.

works.title: Learning to Predict by the Methods of Temporal Differences
works.summary: Predict without waiting for the outcome: bootstrap each estimate off the next one.
works.mechanism: TD(lambda): eligibility traces blend Monte Carlo targets with one-step bootstrapping.

works.title: Q-learning
works.summary: Learn the optimal action-value function off-policy: update toward the best next action whatever you actually did.
works.mechanism: One-step Q-learning with epsilon-greedy exploration; convergence guarantees in the tabular case.

works.title: Simple Statistical Gradient-Following Algorithms for Connectionist Reinforcement Learning
works.summary: Move policy weights uphill on sampled return: the policy-gradient theorem's first practical form.
works.mechanism: REINFORCE with baselines; unbiased but high-variance gradient estimates from full episodes.

works.title: Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction (2nd ed.)
works.authors: R. S. Sutton, A. G. Barto
works.summary: The field's reference text: bandits, DP, TD, function approximation, policy gradients and the deadly triad in one frame.
works.mechanism: Textbook synthesis, not one algorithm: the multi-step bootstrapping view that unifies the families.

works.title: Concrete Problems in AI Safety
works.summary: Names the failure agenda for RL agents: reward hacking, side effects, scalable oversight, safe exploration, distributional shift.
works.mechanism: Problem taxonomy with accident-driven research directions; no new algorithm.

works.title: Human-level Control through Deep Reinforcement Learning
works.summary: One network, one algorithm, 49 Atari games from pixels: deep RL's founding demonstration.
works.mechanism: Deep Q-network with experience replay and a frozen target network to stabilise bootstrapping.

works.title: Asynchronous Methods for Deep Reinforcement Learning
works.summary: Parallel actors decorrelate experience: stable policy learning with no replay buffer.
works.mechanism: Asynchronous advantage actor-critic; n-step returns with a learned baseline.

works.title: Trust Region Policy Optimization
works.summary: Monotonic improvement by constraining each update inside a KL trust region around the old policy.
works.mechanism: Constrained optimisation on the surrogate advantage with a KL-divergence bound and line search.

works.title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
works.summary: TRPO's stability with first-order simplicity: clip the objective and it just works — the default RL optimizer for a decade.
works.mechanism: Clipped surrogate objective with multiple minibatch epochs; the KL anchor behind RLHF fine-tuning.

works.title: Rainbow: Combining Improvements in Deep Reinforcement Learning
works.summary: Seven DQN extensions in one agent: the ablation that shows which value-method ideas actually stack.
works.mechanism: Double, dueling, prioritized replay, multi-step, distributional, noisy nets in a single update.

works.title: Soft Actor-Critic: Off-Policy Maximum Entropy Deep RL
works.summary: Maximise return plus entropy: the sample-efficient continuous-control standard that explores by staying stochastic.
works.mechanism: Off-policy actor-critic on the maximum-entropy objective with twin critics and auto-tuned temperature.

works.title: Addressing Function Approximation Error in Actor-Critic Methods
works.summary: Twin critics, delayed policy updates, target smoothing: the overestimation fix for deterministic policies.
works.mechanism: Clipped double Q-learning with delayed actor updates on top of DDPG.

works.title: Mastering the Game of Go with Deep Neural Networks and Tree Search
works.summary: Supervised policy plus value network plus Monte Carlo tree search beats the European champion 5-0.
works.mechanism: SL policy init, RL policy improvement by self-play, value network, MCTS at decision time.

works.title: Mastering Atari, Go, Chess and Shogi by Planning with a Learned Model
works.summary: Plan without knowing the rules: learn a latent dynamics model and search inside it.
works.mechanism: Representation, dynamics and prediction networks trained end-to-end; MCTS over learned latent states.

works.title: Dream to Control: Learning Behaviors by Latent Imagination
works.summary: Learn a world model from pixels, then learn the policy purely by imagining trajectories inside it.
works.mechanism: Latent state-space world model; actor-critic trained on imagined rollouts, not environment steps.

works.title: Evolution Strategies as a Scalable Alternative to Reinforcement Learning
works.summary: Black-box parameter search scales linearly with workers and needs no gradients, backprop or value functions.
works.mechanism: Gaussian perturbations of the parameter vector; update along the reward-weighted average direction.

works.title: Conservative Q-Learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning
works.summary: Offline Q-learning overestimates the unseen: learn a lower bound on values so the policy trusts only the data.
works.mechanism: Conservative regulariser penalising out-of-distribution action values on top of standard Bellman updates.

works.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Implicit Q-Learning
works.summary: Never ask what unseen actions are worth: fit values with expectile regression on in-sample actions only.
works.mechanism: Implicit Q-learning via expectiles; policy extraction by advantage-weighted regression, no OOD queries.

works.title: Decision Transformer: RL via Sequence Modeling
works.summary: Treat RL as next-token prediction conditioned on desired return: the transformer is the policy.
works.mechanism: Offline trajectories as return-state-action sequences; condition on return-to-go at inference.

works.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning from Human Preferences
works.summary: Learn the reward from human comparisons, then RL on the learned reward: the preference-RL template.
works.mechanism: Bradley-Terry reward model on trajectory-pair labels; policy optimisation against the fitted reward.

works.title: Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback
works.summary: Supervise, rank, reinforce: the three-stage RLHF recipe that made assistants follow instructions.
works.mechanism: SFT, then preference reward model, then PPO with a KL anchor to the supervised policy.

works.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
works.summary: Replace most human labels with model self-critique against a written constitution: supervision scales without proportional labelling.
works.mechanism: Supervised critique-revision, then preference modelling on AI-ranked pairs, then RL — RLAIF.

works.title: Direct Preference Optimization
works.summary: Skip the reward model: the optimal-policy equation turns pairwise preferences directly into a classification loss.
works.mechanism: Closed-form reward reparameterisation; supervised-style loss with a reference-policy KL term.

works.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via RL
works.summary: Pure RL on verifiable rewards lets long reasoning chains emerge with no supervised reasoning traces — then distil them.
works.mechanism: GRPO on rule-checked outcomes (math, code); cold-start SFT plus rejection-sampled RL for the released model.

works.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
works.authors: N. Shinn, F. Cassano, E. Gopinath, K. Narasimhan, S. Yao
works.summary: The RL update is prose: reflect on failure in words, store the reflection, condition on it next episode.
works.mechanism: Actor-evaluator-self-reflection loop with episodic verbal memory; binary or scalar task reward gates what is kept.

works.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
works.summary: A growing skill library plus self-verified curriculum: lifelong learning in Minecraft with no weight updates.
works.mechanism: Automatic curriculum, code-skill generation, self-verification gate before library admission.

works.title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
works.summary: Reflect on failures in natural language and propose program edits: prose optimisation that beats RL on sample efficiency.
works.mechanism: Genealogy of candidate programs; failure reflection proposes mutations, evaluation keeps the winners.

works.title: MemRL: Self-Evolving Agents via Runtime Reinforcement Learning on Episodic Memory
works.summary: Run RL at runtime on the memory operators themselves: what to store, retrieve and discard is a learned policy.
works.mechanism: Runtime RL over episodic-memory actions with task-success reward; the lab's reference bands calibrate it.

works.title: A-MEM: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
works.summary: Memory with structure and operators: link notes, evolve them with RL-trained management, forget on principle.
works.mechanism: Zettelkasten-style note graph with learned link, merge and evict operators.

works.title: ReasoningBank: Scaling Agent Self-Evolving with Reasoning Memory
works.summary: A bank of scored reasonings the agent retrieves from and writes back to: memory that compounds across tasks.
works.mechanism: Top-k retrieval of past reasonings keyed on task plus workflow; write-back gated on graded success.

works.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
works.summary: Memory stream plus reflection plus retrieval: believable multi-agent days with no weight updates at all.
works.mechanism: Observation memory with recency-importance-relevance retrieval and periodic natural-language reflection.

works.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
works.summary: Real GitHub issues with hidden tests: the agentic-coding reward that RLVR pipelines optimise against.
works.mechanism: Instance-level fail-to-pass plus pass-to-pass tests; resolved-rate as the binary task reward.

works.title: Continual Learning, Not Training: Online Adaptation For Agents
works.summary: Online adaptation under drift with per-boundary accounting: the continual-RL framing the lab's streams test.
works.mechanism: Experience replay plus scoped consolidation measured with interference and forgetting metrics.

works.title: Gymnasium: The Maintained RL Environment API
works.summary: The standard reset-step loop every RL result runs on: environments as versioned, reproducible harnesses.
works.mechanism: Env API plus vectorised wrappers and seeding discipline; the harness half of every RL claim.
